title: Agentry agent.yaml manifest (schema major 2)
description: Machine form of the QuickAgent manifest after DEV-088: a release declares the run modes it supports (autonomous, interactive) and one instruction entrypoint; the v1 kind classification is gone. Closed schema: unknown keys are invalid everywhere (rule V1). This schema covers the static shape; the context rules V2 (repo identity), V3 (tag equality and channel monotonicity), V4 (include resolution, instruction file present), V7 (public-publish LICENSE/README and SPDX allowlist), V8 (archive quotas) and V9 (frontmatter vs manifest) are enforced by the registry and by pkg/manifest, as are glob validity and the policy-gated "*" egress.

schemaVersion.description: Manifest schema major; this file describes major "2".

name.description: Agent name; must match the target repo (V2) and the §4.2 DDL pattern.

namespace.description: Namespace handle; must match the target repo (V2) and the §4.2 DDL pattern.

modes.description: Run modes the release supports; one or both (V1).

version.description: Strict semver without a leading v; must equal the git tag and exceed every existing version on its channel (V3).

summary.description: Plain single-line text, at most 140 characters (V8).

license.description: SPDX license id; required and checked against the embedded allowlist for public publish (V7).

instruction.description: Repo-relative instruction file; AGENT.md when omitted. A leading YAML frontmatter block is stripped by consumers, so a SKILL.md-shaped file works unchanged. Must exist and be matched by publish.include (V4).

intake.description: Questions asked before a run starts, in either mode (V10). The runner stages the answers read-only for the agent; secret answers are injected as run-scoped secrets, never as text.

interactive.description: Hints for interactive sessions (V10). Limits here can only tighten runner policy.

opening.description: The assistant's first message when no task text was given.

idleTimeoutSeconds.description: End the session after this much silence; policy caps it.

guide.description: The author's words for the run setup, shown to people before a run and never to the agent (V10; plan guided-runs.md §6). Clients derive the same steps from the rest of the manifest when it is absent.

overview.description: What the QuickAgent does and returns, in markdown. At most 4096 bytes (V10 counts bytes). Newlines and tabs are the only control characters it may carry (agentry#558).

prepare.description: What to gather before starting, one plain line each.

files.description: What files to bring to the run, in one plain line.

task.description: The placeholder for the task field.

connect.description: Help per declared secret name: where to create the key and which scopes it needs, in markdown a person reads (never the agent). At most 2,000 characters each; newlines and tabs are the only control characters it may carry (agentry#707). Every key must be a secret the release declares, in capabilities.secrets or a declared MCP server's secrets (V10; JSON schema cannot express that cross-reference).

knowledge.description: The knowledge packs the release ships in its archive under knowledge/<name>/, and what a person may attach of their own (V11; plan knowledge.md §4.6). Each shipped pack is the CLI's layout (manifest.json, wiki/ with index.md and log.md, sources/), at most 10 MB and 2,000 files, outside the archive's own quotas (V8), and scanned with the version. A newly shipped name widens the contract; accepts is shown to people only.

name.description: The pack's name and its directory under knowledge/.

prompt.description: One plain line shown in the run setup's Knowledge step, never to the agent.

required.description: The Knowledge step cannot be skipped.

interfaces.description: Export formats for `agentry install --target`; unrelated to mode.

capabilities.description: THE security contract; closed vocabulary (V5). Empty = pure text. Identical in both modes: an interactive session cannot widen it.

secrets.description: Environment variable NAMES the agent expects; never values.

optionalSecrets.description: The declared secrets (the agent's own or a declared MCP server's) a run can do without; every other declared secret is required. Each must be declared (V5); names only, never values.

mcpServers.description: The MCP servers the agent uses to do its job (RUNNER-PLAN-3); unchanged by DEV-088.

include.description: Archive ALLOWLIST of glob patterns; segments use path.Match syntax and a whole "**" segment matches any number of segments (V4).

relPath.description: Repo-root-relative slash-separated path: not absolute, no "." or ".." segments, no empty segments, no backslashes.

includePattern.description: Like relPath but glob syntax: path.Match per segment plus whole-segment "**"; backslash escapes allowed. Bracket-class validity is checked by pkg/manifest.

hostName.description: Exact DNS host name: dot-separated labels of 1-63 alphanumeric-or-hyphen characters, no leading/trailing hyphen.

egressHost.description: One egress list element: an exact DNS host or "*" (policy-gated). "none" is only valid as the entire egress value.

egress.description: "none", "*" (policy-gated), or a list of exact DNS hosts.

mcpServer.description: A declared MCP server: a package (npm or pypi, with an exact version) or, since agentry#910, a remote server (url, with auth). Exactly one of npm, pypi or url; pkg/manifest holds the cross-field rules this schema cannot express.

url.description: A remote server's HTTPS address: a public lowercase host name, port 443, no user information, query or fragment. pkg/manifest refuses IP literals and internal names.

auth.description: How a remote server is signed in to: oauth (the person's connection), secret (its one declared secret as a bearer header) or none.

version.description: Exact version to install (a package server only).

env.description: Plain, non-secret configuration the server reads from its environment (DEV-098). A name that is also a declared secret is refused by pkg/manifest. Values are literal: one the runner's gateway would rewrite — a `$` followed by a name character, `{` or a special shell parameter, or a `{{…}}` template — is refused (agentry#291).

mcpOAuth.description: A package server's OAuth sign-in (agentry#910): the runner makes or reuses the person's connection with the issuer and renders the access token, and only the access token, into files and env. {access_token} must appear in a template or an env value (pkg/manifest).

path.description: A plain file name in the token folder.

template.description: The file's content. Placeholders: {access_token}, {expiry} (RFC 3339 UTC), {expiry_ms} (Unix milliseconds).

additionalProperties.description: Placeholders: {access_token}, and {dir}, the token folder's path.

id.description: Answer key; unique within the manifest.

version.description: Semver constraint (e.g. "^1.2"); absent means any. Constraint syntax is validated by pkg/manifest.
